name: Rho
summary: Rho issues physical and virtual corporate cards to US-incorporated companies, with limits set per card and no personal guarantee. Its fee summary lists $0 for subscriptions and per-user fees, and cardholders can earn up to 2% cashback on the Platinum tier.

facts.text: Rho says no personal guarantee or personal credit report is required to apply for its corporate card.
Applicants need a US-incorporated company and an EIN. Monthly Terms open at $25,000 held at Rho, or $75,000 combined with linked external accounts, subject to underwriting.
Native accounting integrations named on the card page are QuickBooks Online, NetSuite, Sage Intacct and Puzzle, with bank feed connections to Xero and QuickBooks Online.
Cashback of up to 2% applies to Rho Platinum card spend, and the full statement balance must be paid on time or the cashback is forfeited.
The fee summary lists a 3% late fee on the delinquent balance for each month, for up to six months unless prohibited by law, and 1% for foreign currency transfer and conversion.

plans.name: Rho
plans.notes: The fee summary lists $0 for subscription fees and per-user fees. The card page lists $0 for annual, subscription and per-card fees

hiddenCosts: Foreign currency transfer and conversion costs 1%.
Late payments cost 3% of the delinquent balance each month, for up to six months.
International wire recall costs $30 on a checking account.
Rho Treasury charges an annual fee that ranges from 0.15% for deposits of $20 million or more up to 0.6%.
